message: No detected input validation: The only validation present is a single assertion checking class count (assert args.num_class == len(train_set.classes)), but there are no checks on data structure, dtypes, value ranges, or schema for the loaded datasets.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local paths specified via args (e.g., args.path, args.cfg['data']['train']) with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication of any remote or external source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code intentionally adds stochastic label noise (SLN) and performs label correction during training epochs, but there is no pre-training check that validates label distributions, compares labels against an expected set, or uses a tool like Cleanlab to detect label-flipping anomalies before traini

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code (get_cifar_data, get_FSD_data) only loads datasets and creates DataLoaders with standard transforms; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights and checkpoints (via --resume_from and --pretrained flags) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; there is no integrity validation before loading serialized model state.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only checks that the number of classes matches via an assert, but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard SGD with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD wrapping applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack implementations anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test_loader is used, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no multiple independent metrics beyond loss and accuracy, and no explicit isolation guarantees preventing test-set leakage.
No detected input sanitization: The code moves tensors to device and applies transforms but performs no shape/range validation or schema checks on incoming inputs before passing them to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly for loss computation and accuracy tracking with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation applied to predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline handles image and audio classification (CIFAR and FSD50K), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
